notes.title: TTOO Update
notes.content:
Hey!!!!

 I know it's been a small while since we've pushed out an update for TTOO and let me explain why! We're currently in the process of getting all of our voice over work done and into the game. This means, that during all cutscenes and dialogue there will finally be voices for all of our characters! This small update contains just a small few bug fixes along with adding in an auto save feature that will save your progress every 5 minutes when not on a mission, as well as, making vending machines usable in the game! We appreciate everyone's feedback and we look forward to bringing you more updates for TTOO as time goes on!

notes.title: Update 6/16/24
notes.content:
Below is a small list of fixes that we've pushed out for today:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to skip the opening driving scene.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could start multiple missions at once. Now, you can only do 1 mission at a time. 
[/list]


We appreciate everyone's feedback we've received and are dedicated to fixing any and all issues that are forwarded our way!

notes.title: Update notes for 06/15/24
notes.content:
Game Update v1.03

You talked, we listened. Yes the game might not be perfect but it is early access afterall…
But you know what, we're not a studio that quits on their projects when things get tough! So what do we do? We go back to the drawing board improving and fixing aspects of the game!

Our team has been working extremely hard for the past 2 1/2 weeks to fix a number of issues that we have had with the way the game mechanics work, as you can see from the list below!

As a way of apologizing for some of the minor bugs that we didn't spot during our testing stages we will be releasing our casino expansion pack! Where you are able to play blackjack, slots, spin the wheel and craps with an exclusive poker game to follow! Please feel free to explore!

Also if you would like to follow or even talk to our development team be sure to join us on our discord page: https://discord.gg/yTYbuPAYeu

New Additions:
The casino is now open for business. You can come here and gamble. There are various blackjack tables, craps tables, slot machines and spin the wheel games.
You can also buy a motel room here to save your progress when not on a mission.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3]
- When crashing your vehicle into other vehicles, buildings, etc the player will now take damage.
- Vehicles will now get dirty over time and can be washed at the car wash, located near the hospital.
- We've added new vehicle colors.
- We've added the ability to skip cutscenes. You can skip them by holding return or A on your controller for 3 seconds.


[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
- Fixed an issue where bullets were not registering when shooting at enemies.
- Fixed the death system. When dying you would respawn back at your last position. You will now respawn at the hospital.
- Fixed an issue where JoJo would not attack enemies.
- Fixed an issue with the passengers sit point inside of the Sedan vehicle.
- Fixed an issue with Jenny not following Vinny when leaving the restaurant. 
- Fixed an issue with 
- Fixed the car speed on the first mission when driving to the strip club.
